name: REVIEWS.io
description: REVIEWS.io is a reputation and review platform for company and product reviews, review invitations, widgets, questions, surveys, product catalogs, and ecommerce integrations.
agentUseSummary: REVIEWS.io cannot yet be connected through Relay. Its API uses a paid customer's dashboard-generated Store ID and confidential API key, and the same credential can retrieve review content and submit customer/order data that triggers email or SMS invitations, requiring representative entitlement and authority acceptance first.

credentialRequirements.name: REVIEWS_IO_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: REVIEWS.io API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: Customer-generated confidential key stored only in Railway's encrypted credential boundary.

credentialRequirements.name: REVIEWS_IO_STORE_ID
credentialRequirements.label: REVIEWS.io Store ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Customer Store ID or url_key paired with the API key.

blocked.label: Collect REVIEWS.io credentials
blocked.description: Relay does not collect a customer's Store ID or API key before paid-account entitlement and authority acceptance.

blocked.label: Read reviews
blocked.description: Company reviews, product reviews, ratings, widgets, questions, surveys, and product catalog data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Queue review invitations
blocked.description: Submitting customer names, emails, order IDs, products, or triggering email/SMS review requests remains unavailable.

blocked.label: Use raw APIs or mutations
blocked.description: Arbitrary endpoints, region substitution, imports, feeds, automatic pagination, broad export, and every other write are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No REVIEWS.io action is enabled before customer credential and entitlement acceptance.

runtimeSupport.description: No REVIEWS.io wrappers are mounted until a representative paid-account key establishes the exact authority contract.
No REVIEWS.io wrappers are mounted until a representative paid-account key establishes the exact authority contract.

providerSetup.blocker: REVIEWS.io API access is plan-gated and requires a customer to retrieve a Store ID and confidential API key from its dashboard. Official examples show that the credential can both retrieve reviews and queue external review invitations with personal customer/order data; no representative credential, entitlement, rotation, or revocation evidence is available.
providerSetup.nextAction: The exclusive provider-console and production-acceptance task should obtain authorization from a representative Grow/Plus customer, generate a dedicated key without exposing it in reports, record the exact regional endpoint and enabled read/write products, verify rotation/revocation, and return frozen schemas and quotas before connector implementation.

evidence.supports: REVIEWS.io documents a unique customer Store ID and API key in Integrations > API and states API publishing access requires the Plus plan.
REVIEWS.io documents Store ID/API-key review reads and a POST invitation endpoint carrying customer name, email, order, and product data.
REVIEWS.io documents Plus-plan Reviews API access, Store ID/API key authentication, product review reads, rating batches, and catalog prerequisites.
REVIEWS.io documents Grow-plan customer credentials used to queue merchant and product invitations, demonstrating communication authority.
